analysis.title: Advanced Analysis & Predictions
analysis.subtitle: Crop stress, disease risk, irrigation need & nutrient analysis powered by GEE satellite + weather data.
analysis.noDataDesc: Metrics will appear once GEE data and weather data are loaded
analysis.irr_highSum: Soil moisture is low ({{val}} mm). Crops likely need watering soon.
analysis.irr_modSum: Soil moisture is moderate ({{val}} mm). Monitor and irrigate if needed.
analysis.irr_lowSum: Soil moisture is adequate ({{val}} mm). No immediate irrigation needed.
analysis.irr_highRec: Schedule irrigation within 24 hours. Consider drip irrigation for water efficiency.
analysis.irr_modRec: Continue monitoring. Prepare irrigation plan if dry spell continues.
analysis.irr_lowRec: Current moisture levels are sufficient. Check again in 2-3 days.
analysis.fun_highSum: High humidity ({{val}}%) creates favorable conditions for fungal infections.
analysis.fun_modSum: Humidity levels ({{val}}%) are moderate. Some fungal risk exists.
analysis.fun_lowSum: Low fungal risk at current humidity ({{val}}%).
analysis.fun_highRec: Apply preventive fungicide. Ensure proper plant spacing for air circulation.
analysis.fun_modRec: Monitor leaf surfaces for early signs of fungal growth.
analysis.fun_lowRec: No fungal intervention needed at this time.
analysis.et_highSum: High evapotranspiration (ET ≈ {{val}} mm/day). Rapid water loss from soil and plants.
analysis.et_modSum: Moderate ET rate. Water loss is manageable but worth monitoring.
analysis.et_lowSum: Low ET rate. Minimal water loss from evapotranspiration.
analysis.et_highRec: Increase irrigation by ~{{val}} mm/day. Mulching can reduce soil evaporation.
analysis.et_modRec: Standard irrigation schedule should suffice. Consider mulching.
analysis.et_lowRec: Current water retention is good. No adjustment needed.
analysis.str_highSum: Crops are under significant environmental stress. Yield may be impacted.
analysis.str_modSum: Moderate stress levels detected. Some protective measures recommended.
analysis.str_lowSum: Low stress — crops are in a favorable environment.
analysis.str_highRec: Prioritize irrigation, consider shade nets for heat, and apply foliar nutrients.
analysis.str_modRec: Monitor closely and prepare for protective action if conditions worsen.
analysis.str_lowRec: Conditions are suitable for healthy growth. Continue normal practices.
analysis.gro_highSum: Excellent growing conditions across all measured parameters.
analysis.gro_modSum: Acceptable conditions, but some factors need monitoring.
analysis.gro_lowSum: Poor growing conditions. Multiple parameters outside optimal ranges.
analysis.gro_highRec: Great conditions! Maintain current practices for optimal yield.
analysis.gro_modRec: Address the limiting factors highlighted below to improve growth.
analysis.gro_lowRec: Take corrective action. Focus on the critical parameters listed below.
analysis.ph_vAcidSum: Soil pH is {{val}}. Very acidic — aluminum toxicity risk.
analysis.ph_mAcidSum: Soil pH is {{val}}. Moderately acidic — reduced P and Mo availability.
analysis.ph_optSum: Soil pH is {{val}}. Optimal — most nutrients are readily available.
analysis.ph_sAlkSum: Soil pH is {{val}}. Slightly alkaline — Fe and Mn may decrease.
analysis.ph_alkSum: Soil pH is {{val}}. Alkaline — Fe, Zn, Mn, B deficiency risk.
analysis.ph_hAlkSum: Soil pH is {{val}}. Highly alkaline — severe micronutrient lockout.
analysis.ph_vAcidRec: Apply agricultural lime (dolomite/calcite) to raise pH. Supplement P, Ca, Mg.
analysis.ph_mAcidRec: Liming recommended. Add bone meal or rock phosphate for phosphorus.
analysis.ph_optRec: pH is ideal. Maintain with balanced fertilization and organic matter.
analysis.ph_sAlkRec: Monitor for iron chlorosis (yellowing leaves). Apply chelated iron if needed.
analysis.ph_alkRec: Apply sulfur or acidifying fertilizers. Use chelated micronutrients.
analysis.ph_hAlkRec: Urgent pH correction needed. Apply elemental sulfur and gypsum.
analysis.ph_vAcidNut: Very acidic — Aluminum toxicity risk. Phosphorus, calcium, and magnesium deficiency likely.
analysis.ph_mAcidNut: Moderately acidic — Reduced phosphorus and molybdenum availability.
analysis.ph_optNut: Optimal pH range — Most macro and micronutrients are readily available.
analysis.ph_sAlkNut: Slightly alkaline — Iron and manganese availability may decrease.
analysis.ph_alkNut: Alkaline — Iron, zinc, manganese, and boron deficiency risk.
analysis.ph_hAlkNut: Highly alkaline — Severe micronutrient lockout. Most crops will struggle.
analysis.cond_tempOpt: ✅ Temperature ({{val}}°C) is in the optimal range
analysis.cond_tempOk: ⚠️ Temperature ({{val}}°C) is acceptable but not ideal
analysis.cond_humOpt: ✅ Humidity ({{val}}%) is optimal for most crops
analysis.cond_humOk: ⚠️ Humidity ({{val}}%) is slightly out of range
analysis.cond_phOpt: ✅ Soil pH ({{val}}) is in the healthy range
analysis.cond_phOk: ⚠️ Soil pH ({{val}}) may limit nutrient uptake
analysis.cond_phBad: ❌ Soil pH ({{val}}) is extreme — amendment needed

forecastAlerts.droughtHigh: ⚠️ High drought risk detected! Low rainfall and vegetation stress observed.
forecastAlerts.droughtMod: Moderate drought risk — monitor soil moisture and plan irrigation.
forecastAlerts.floodHigh: 🌊 High flood risk! Heavy rainfall expected. Secure crops and drainage.
forecastAlerts.floodMod: Moderate flood risk — prepare drainage and avoid low-lying areas.
forecastAlerts.heatHigh: 🔥 Severe heat stress alert! Extreme temperatures may damage crops.
forecastAlerts.heatMod: Moderate heat stress — ensure adequate irrigation and shade.
forecastAlerts.droughtRec: Increase irrigation frequency. Apply mulch to retain soil moisture. Consider drought-resistant crop varieties.
forecastAlerts.floodRec: Clear drainage channels. Protect seedlings. Avoid fertilizer application before heavy rain.
forecastAlerts.heatRec: Irrigate during early morning or late evening. Use shade nets. Apply foliar sprays to reduce heat stress.
